svg.text: Reads are public (edge-cached); writes require Cognito auth. One container image serves split read/write services behind an ALB.

Dashed = not exercised end-to-end yet: CloudFront needs AWS account verification, so the CDN edge-cache path is unverified. Dev uses the same Terraform on the Floci emulator. AWS icons: awslabs/aws-icons-for-plantuml (Apache-2.0).
